text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — I'm starting the ingest/merge of the new promptsets from nova13b and qbench models. Need a de-dupe gating plan + golden-set update cadence before we run quant canaries.
Devon: What's the immediate scope? full promptbank merge or just longform/instructions?
Maya: Start with instruction-style + longform first (≈120k rows). We'll exclude paraphrases for this pass.
Liam: For dedupe I recommend two-stage: fingerprint hash (sha256 of normalized text) then token-overlap. Keeps speed and precision.
Anya: Labeling note — we have ~40 labelers next week, but throughput drops 30% for longforms. If we push 120k we'll need 10-day window or sampling.
Devon: Proposal: gate merge by dedupe pass + small canary sample (2k) for golden validators. If canary fails, stop automated merge.
Maya: Sounds good. Can we codify the gate? e.g.,
```
curate-cli ingest --src nova13b.csv --tag nova13b-ingest
curate-cli dedupe --keys fingerprint,tokenspan --threshold 0.915
curate-cli sample --tag nova13b-ingest --size 2000 --out canary.csv
```
Liam: threshold 0.915 seems reasonable but prefer token overlap fallback: jaccard > 0.85 => treat as duplicate. Also add special handling for code blocks/SQL.
Devon: I'll add a tokenizer-normalize step: lower, strip punctuation, collapse whitespace, preserve code fences.
Anya: For golden set — recommend 1k stable anchors + 1k fresh from the canary. Golden validators should do blind review (no model labels) in LabelFlow.
LabelFlowBot: Reminder: golden update run scheduled when YAML flag `golden_update: true` appears in job config. Use `labelflow run --golden` to reserve validators.
Ops: Quant canary note — run q8b and int4 variants against canary.csv; measure QA-hallucination-rate, instr-coherence delta, and lat50/90. If QA-hallucination-rate increases >2.5% vs baseline, fail gate.
Maya: Can everyone own these pieces: Devon -> dedupe pipeline and commands; Liam -> canary evaluation metrics script; Anya -> labeler scheduling + golden validators; Ops -> quant canary infra/runbook? I'll coordinate merge once green.
Devon: Assigned. I'll push dedupe config to `eng-ml/curation/configs/nova13b-dedupe.yaml` and open a PR with sample commands.
Liam: I'll prepare a lightweight eval harness and a short README with pass/fail thresholds.
Anya: I'll reserve 20 validators for the canary window and prep the blind label flows. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Ops: I'll queue the quant canaries after canary.csv lands in s3://redwood-curation/canaries/6311112222/ and trigger the runbook.
Maya: Great — ping here when the PR is up. If we see any surprising duplicate density (>60%) we'll discuss reduction strategies (smaller merge, more aggressive dedupe).
Devon: One practical ask: include `source_model` and `ingest_batch` in metadata so we can triage provenance easily.
Maya: Will do. Thanks all :thumbsup:
LabelFlowBot: golden_update job queued by Anya — job id gf-2026-6311
Ops: Noted. I'll watch metrics and report back.
Maya: Closing loop — target merge earliest Thu 03:00 UTC pending canary pass.
Liam: ack.
Anya: ack.
Devon: ack.
LabelFlowBot: Reaction :white_check_mark: logged.
Ops: :rocket:
